notes.title: Fireheart - Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Greetings fellow adventurers![/b] It has been a long time since the last update, so I am happy to release this one! It has been a long time coming and I hope that you will be happy with it!

[b]Added:[/b]
- Slight performance increase
- Added a new key item
- new dungeon
- new boss
- Added a new achievement


[b]Changes:[/b]
- Adjusted stats of all bosses
- Lowered Life Crystal prices
- Lowered Green Health Potion prices
- Lowered Resurrection Costs
- Rebalanced some low level enemies
- Adjusted some enemy drops

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed various player rotation bugs
- Fixed 3 achievements that were not detected
- Fixed a bug where players were able to attack while talking to someone
- Fixed a bug where players were able to fly
- Fixed various sound bugs

[b]As always, thank you for playing this game.[/b]

Cheers,
Mike

notes.title: Fireheart - Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Hello adventurers![/b] Here is the newest patch that has some improvements. The highlight would be the private chest that allows you to equip already crafted weapons without cost.

[b]Changes:[/b]

- Changed cultist camp difficulty
- Improved enemy AI
- Improved some UI visuals
- Moved arena barrier at Fireheart a bit

- Added a private chest
[b]Explanation:[/b] You can now equip all your crafted weapons at your private chest. Please note, that this is completely new, and your already crafted weapons before the patch will not be shown in the chest. They are located in all towns and villages.

- Added new achievements
- Added a button to open all character screens ( it is [P])
- Added more companion names
- Added more general companion lines
- Added special companion lines
- You can now buy and sell pears
- Changed footstep sounds
- Attack speed increase now applies to skills as well

[b]Fixes:[/b]

- Fixed some NPC spawns in Darkbloom


I hope that you like this patch! I wish you all a great time playing this game!

Cheers,
Mike

notes.title: Fireheart - Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here is a bigger patch. A few more additions and fixes. I also worked on performance so it should be a bit smoother now.

[b][u]Additions / improvements:[/u][/b]
- Improved performance
- Added name for support aura icon when being hovered
- Added barrier skill for Larus
- Added barrier skill for elite warrior cultists
- Added a level to the Priest in Dent
- Added camera distance reset when stamina hits zero
- Added 3 more caves with treasures to discover
- Changed NPC placements in Cameron
- Crystal swords now apply status effects
- Changed location of a gold chest
- Changed gold chest drops
- Changed Nightbringer damage to magical
- Slighty improved Nightbringer appearance
- Opened shop and inn doors to make it clear that players can enter these buildings
- Slightly changed silver chest drops
- Changed Stone Golem health to intended value
- Buffed Grey Dragon stats
- Changed dragon name to Grey Dragon
- Changed Grey Dragon to only drop one thing :eyes:

[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]
- Fixed a bug where stats on the shard buttons did not update when equipping new gear
- Fixed various shard button bugs
- Fixed a bug where loading the game changes the players magical damage to physical
- Fixed a bug where companions could be poisoned for all eternity
- Fixed a bug where the support aura icon is not being displayed for all companions


Let me know if you have a problem or a question! Please also free to review the game if you have time.

Thank you and I wish you a happy adventure!

Cheers,
Mike

- Adjusted Skeleton Archer stats

- Reduced Green Health Potion cost by 10

- Fixed Fall Cut animation
- Added a small delay for fall cut and power slash after the attack

Thanks for playing and I wish you all a great adventure!

Cheers,
Mike

notes.title: Fireheart - Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Here is another quick one. Coming with a bunch of fixes.

- Fixed Musho AI to not attack each other (I really fixed it now)
- Fixed Inn keeper in Verusio, you can now talk to her.
- Fixed Inn sleeping gold calculation, sleeping at an inn now deducts gold
- Fixed the "Until The End" quest
- Fixed "Not A Coincidence" quest
- Fixed a bug where teleporting from Cameron to Mern would let you fall through the ground
- Added sound to train buttons
- Fixed Boss AoE skills
- Adjusted Stone Golem difficulty

The next update will take a little bit more time.

Thank you for playing this game!

Kind regards,
Mike
